scope_note: Integration truth for the Section 9 residual-artifact fingerprint after PR #165. The preferred source/envelope constructors compute one SHA-256 directly from exact nonempty raw artifact bytes and therefore reject bytewise source drift without a caller-supplied digest. This is content-addressed audit identity only, not evidence that the bytes are the manuscript Eq. (9.21) residual or that Eq. (9.18) majorants were derived from it.

layers.landed_capability: Preferred content-addressed witnesses derive a canonical SHA-256 from the exact serialized residual-artifact bytes with no decoding or normalization; empty/non-bytes fail closed and bytewise-different source/envelope artifacts fail digest binding before the existing Eq. (9.18) source gate runs.
layers.compatibility_boundary: Lower-level constructors that accept an already-computed canonical digest remain available; direct digest acceptance is compatibility plumbing and is not promoted to independent mathematical evidence.
layers.remaining_boundary: Construct/import the genuine manuscript-derived Eq. (9.21) residual artifact from actual Section 7/8 data and derive the uniform Eq. (9.18) envelope ladder from that same artifact. Then prove the infinite Section 9 sequence/Proposition 9.9 closure and the downstream endpoint, Borel, forcing, energy, and blow-up obligations. A SHA-256 match alone proves none of these.
